svg.title: Playable port — validation mosaic
svg.desc: Green: observed or tested within the stated scope. Amber: partial. Red: work or validation still open, including known issues. Cells are checklist items, not PSP routines or weighted work percentages. This expanding checklist is not the complete original-game scope.
svg.text: Two story missions owner-tested. Campaign, PSP services, fidelity and performance validation continue.
Each tile is a specific scenario or check — automatic code generation does not turn it green.

Full PSP scope sign-off: The complete original-game feature/mode checklist has not been accepted.

svg.text: Green applies only to each named check. Red does not assert a missing implementation; it also includes untested behavior.
Expanding validation checklist, not a complete feature inventory. Tile areas do not measure remaining effort or overall completion.
